component.name: Cellular Settings
蜂窝网络设置
component.summary: Network mode, network preference and mobile data connections of the modem
基带的网络模式、网络偏好和移动数据连接

description.p: What the desktop's settings leave out for the cellular modem: the technologies the modem may use, with 4G and 5G alone among them; how the modem asks the network for service, which has to be "EPS only, data-centric" on a network without a circuit-switched domain; the last reason the network gave for a refusal; and the mobile data connections, with their access point and how often they are dialled.
The choice can be kept for the next boot. The status of the modem, the network and the device is shown as it changes.
